title: equisetum × jesupii
intro: Equisetum × jesupii, commonly known as the western swamp horsetail, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been employed in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and enhancing immune function. The western swamp horsetail is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and silicates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties. The plant's extracts have been used to treat a range of health conditions, including arthritis, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.
